title: GovJobs — Content Essentials

fields.label: Organization
fields.name: organization
fields.instructions: Recruiting body, e.g. "Staff Selection Commission". Shown in the post header, cards and schema.org markup.

fields.label: Short Description
fields.name: short_description
fields.instructions: 2–3 sentences. Used on listing cards and as the meta description fallback if no SEO plugin value exists. Aim for 140–158 characters.

fields.label: Important Dates
fields.name: important_dates
fields.instructions: Every date a candidate needs. Put the application deadline on its own row and switch Highlight on — the frontend uses that row for the countdown, the "days left" badge and schema.org validThrough.

sub_fields.label: Date
sub_fields.name: date
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty and type free text instead (e.g. "Before Exam") if the date is not announced yet.

sub_fields.label: Highlight
sub_fields.name: emphasis
sub_fields.instructions: Highlighted rows get an accent background and drive deadline logic.

fields.label: Application Fee
fields.name: application_fee
fields.instructions: One row per category. Enter 0 for free — the frontend renders it as a green "Free" pill rather than "₹0".

sub_fields.label: Amount (₹)
sub_fields.name: amount
sub_fields.instructions: Digits only, or 0 for free. "100" renders as ₹100/-.

fields.label: Official Website
fields.name: official_website
fields.instructions: Full URL including https://. Also used as the fallback for the Apply Online button when that field is empty.

fields.label: Apply Online Link
fields.name: apply_online_link
fields.instructions: Direct link to the application form or registration portal. Shown as the primary orange button on mobile.

fields.label: Official Notification (PDF)
fields.name: notification_pdf
fields.instructions: Upload the official notification PDF. IMPORTANT: set Return Value to "File URL" in the field settings — the frontend expects a URL string, though it also handles the array/object return formats.

fields.label: How to Apply
fields.name: how_to_apply
fields.instructions: Numbered steps. Keep it practical: where to register, what to upload, how to pay.

description: Fields present on every GovJobs post type. These map 1:1 to the structured tables on the frontend — if you add a field here, add it to src/lib/wp.ts too (npm run wp:fields checks this).

title: GovJobs — Eligibility, Age & Vacancies

fields.label: Educational Qualification
fields.name: qualification
fields.instructions: Plain sentence, e.g. "Bachelor's Degree in any stream from a recognised university." Appears in the Quick Summary box and in schema.org educationRequirements.

fields.label: Job Location
fields.name: job_location
fields.instructions: e.g. "All India", "Uttar Pradesh", "New Delhi". Used for schema.org addressRegion.

fields.label: Age Limit
fields.name: age_limit
fields.instructions: Leave blank for posts with no age criteria (e.g. many admissions). Empty fields render nothing rather than an empty table.

sub_fields.label: Age calculated as on
sub_fields.name: as_on
sub_fields.instructions: The cut-off date the age is calculated against.

sub_fields.label: Age Relaxation
sub_fields.name: relaxation
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. "SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years"

fields.label: Total Vacancies
fields.name: total_vacancies
fields.instructions: Digits only, e.g. 17727 — the frontend adds the thousands separators (renders as 17,727). Non-numeric values like "280+ Universities" are also accepted and shown verbatim.

fields.label: Featured
fields.name: is_featured
fields.instructions: Pins the post to the homepage hero panel and adds a "Featured" badge.

fields.label: Vacancy Details
fields.name: vacancy_details
fields.instructions: One row per post. The Total row of the rendered table is taken from "Total Vacancies" above, not from these rows — so you cannot publish a table that contradicts its own total.

sub_fields.label: Post-specific eligibility
sub_fields.name: eligibility
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Use when different posts in the same notification need different qualifications.

description: Eligibility, age and vacancy data. These drive the Quick Summary box, the Age Limit and Vacancy Details tables, and the JobPosting schema.
